title: content router
description: Sends the message along the first outbound link whose condition (the link's language and expression) holds, else along the link without a condition.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect. The conditions are the language and expression of the outbound links

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: The namespace the prefix ns stands for in xpath conditions, such as /ns:order/ns:id

exchangePattern.title: Exchange pattern
exchangePattern.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect
